title: GAP Waiver Premier 150 Worksheet: Covered Loan-to-Value Reduction by Credit Tier
content:
The covered loan-to-value percent of a GAP Waiver Addenda Premier 150 worksheet benefit is reduced by a credit-tier reduction. The reduction follows the credit tier of the Retail Installment Contracts contract, as the contract record shows it.

| Contract credit tier | Credit-tier reduction |
|---|---|
| Tier 4 Standard | 20 points |
| Tier 5 Rebuild | 20 points |
| Tier 6 Fresh Start | 20 points |
| Tier 2 Preferred | 10 points |
| Tier 3 Advantage | 10 points |
| Tier 1 Select | no reduction |

The reduction is subtracted from the plan's highest covered loan-to-value percent before the covered limit is figured.

*Hypothetical case.* A Tier 3 Advantage contract's covered percent of 150 falls by 10 points to 140. A Tier 1 Select contract keeps 150.
